## Convert Quote to Invoice

Turns a won Quote into a draft Invoice. The invoice belongs to the quote's deal account and owner, carries a copy of the quote's line items, and is numbered with `nextInvoiceNumber()`. When a Tax Jurisdiction is supplied, it runs Calculate Tax on the line-item total and attaches the Tax Breakdown.

```ts
import ConvertQuoteToInvoiceCommand from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/commerce/commands/convert-quote-to-invoice-command';

let { invoice, message } = await new ConvertQuoteToInvoiceCommand(
  commandContext,
).execute({ quote, jurisdiction });
```

Only a quote with status `won` converts, and its deal needs an account. A quote whose line items are in more than one currency is refused, since they can't be totalled for one invoice.

The invoice links back to its quote and is created at a path named after it, `Invoice/<quote>` in the target realm, only if nothing is there yet. Every run reads that path first, so running the command again returns the same invoice, even before the index has caught up and whatever the quote's status is by then. A file at that path that belongs to another quote is refused. An invoice made some other way, such as by hand, is found through the index once it is indexed.

### Example

The Acme Enterprise Renewal quote, version 2, which was won.

### Non-goals

Sending the invoice, payment terms beyond the draft, and partial invoicing of a quote.
